intro.title: Maa Durga Gemstone Idols
intro.descriptionHtml: Alluring range of Maa durga gemstone Murtis (Idols) diligently crafted from 100% natural Gomedh, Jade, Crystal Quartz, Sapphire, Topaz, Ruby and other gemstones. We also have idols enriched with hand-paintwork for aesthetic appeal. These Durga idols with additional benefits of gemstones make powerful Vastu rectifiers to place in your home or office. You may place this idol in the North East corner of the house. Goddess Durga represents power, victory, determination, energy and positive energies that destroys and protects from all negative energies.
